title: b7z9.29.3: Python+Rust: implement BusyPercent TX-time airtime sampler
description: Spec R-02a-131: BusyPercent MUST be TX-time based occupancy, MUST NOT be RSSI-derived. No sampler exists in any language. Implement: accumulate own TX airtime per superframe, compute BusyPercent = (tx_airtime / slot_duration) * 100 over RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF rolling window. Feed into interference_score_tenths() which already exists in Rust (rf_health.rs:100-107). Add unit tests.
